$comment: Leaderboard display-name rule (gap row-09), read by ios MorseKitCheck and android/desktop JUnit. Data, not code. Derived from the server rule (names.ts) and the iOS messages: normalise (trim, uppercase, collapse whitespace); then in this order: length 2-12 -> 'must be 2 to 12 characters'; first char A-Z/0-9 and the rest A-Z, 0-9, space, / or - -> 'may use letters, digits, space, / and -'; the name's letters, squashed together, containing FUCK SHIT CUNT NIGG FAG KIKE SPIC RAPE NAZI HITLER -> 'not allowed'. normalized is null whenever there is a problem.
